ex.en: The injury was a major setback for the young athlete's career.
ex.zh: 这次受伤对这位年轻运动员的职业生涯是重大挫折。

words.note: set + back 字面「往回推」，引申为挫折、倒退。

ex.en: Local residents complained about the noise from the new factory.
ex.zh: 当地居民抱怨新工厂的噪音。

words.note: resident 指居民或住院、住校者；动词是 reside。

ex.en: The white dove is symbolic of peace in many cultures.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，白鸽象征和平。

words.note: be symbolic of 后接所象征之物；名词是 symbol。

ex.en: Children learn to distinguish between fact and opinion at an early age.
ex.zh: 儿童在很早的年龄就学会区分事实与观点。

words.note: distinguish A from B 或 between A and B。

ex.en: We spent the whole afternoon at the shopping mall looking for shoes.
ex.zh: 我们在购物中心逛了一下午，想买鞋。

words.note: mall 多指室内大型购物中心，英式常说 shopping centre。

ex.en: The online course is divided into six modules, each lasting a week.
ex.zh: 这门在线课程分为六个模块，每个模块持续一周。

words.note: module 指课程或系统中的独立单元，如 training module。

ex.en: The wind howled all night and kept the whole family awake.
ex.zh: 风呼啸了一整夜，让全家人都睡不着。

words.note: howl 指狗长声嚎叫，也形容风声、大笑或哀号。

ex.en: The team executed the plan perfectly and finished two days early.
ex.zh: 团队完美执行了计划，提前两天完成。

words.note: execute 表「执行」比 do 正式，也可指处死与运行程序。

ex.en: The charity received a substantial amount of money from an unknown donor.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构收到一位匿名捐赠者的一大笔钱。

words.note: substantial 指数量可观或「实质的」，比 large 正式。

ex.en: Small farmers benefit most from the new irrigation programme.
ex.zh: 小农户从新的灌溉计划中受益最多。

words.note: benefit sb 有益于；benefit from 受益于，注意介词。

ex.en: She called me from a phone booth at the corner of the street.
ex.zh: 她在街角的电话亭给我打了电话。

words.note: booth 指隔开的小间，如电话亭、投票亭、展位。

ex.en: The students were enthusiastic about the idea of starting a school garden.
ex.zh: 学生们对开办校园菜园的想法很有热情。

words.note: be enthusiastic about 后接名词；名词是 enthusiasm。

ex.en: The decision to cut safety checks had disastrous consequences for the factory.
ex.zh: 削减安全检查的决定给工厂带来了灾难性后果。

words.note: disaster 加 -ous 变形容词，注意拼写非 disasterous。

ex.en: This problem is unique to small towns where few doctors work.
ex.zh: 这个问题只有医生稀少的小镇才会出现。

words.note: unique 为绝对形容词，不用 very 修饰。

ex.en: The company uses modern software for data processing and storage.
ex.zh: 该公司使用现代软件进行数据处理和存储。

words.note: processing 多作定语，如 data processing。

ex.en: The tax cut is expected to boost spending among low-income families.
ex.zh: 减税预计会提振低收入家庭的消费。

words.note: boost 比 increase 更强调有力推动，常接 economy、sales。

ex.en: She bought the expensive coat on impulse and regretted it later.
ex.zh: 她一时冲动买下那件昂贵的大衣，后来就后悔了。

words.note: on impulse 表「一时冲动地」；形容词是 impulsive。

ex.en: After the accident he decided to stay sober for the rest of the year.
ex.zh: 事故之后，他决定这一年里都不再喝酒。

words.note: sober 本义「未醉的」，引申为严肃、冷静的。

ex.en: Years of discussion finally crystallized into a clear plan for reform.
ex.zh: 多年的讨论最终凝成了一份清晰的改革方案。

words.note: 本义「结晶」，引申指想法、计划变得清晰明确。

ex.en: The festival is both a religious ceremony and a popular street party.
ex.zh: 这个节日既是宗教仪式，也是受欢迎的街头聚会。

words.note: religious 是 religion 的形容词；beliefs 常用复数。

ex.en: The doctor warned that the disease was highly infectious and spread quickly.
ex.zh: 医生警告说这种病传染性很强，传播迅速。

words.note: infect 加 -ious；除「传染的」还指「有感染力的」。

ex.en: We took shelter under a tree until the heavy rain stopped.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树下，直到大雨停了。

words.note: take shelter from 后接风雨等；shelter 名动同形。

ex.en: She became a prominent figure in the fight for cleaner air.
ex.zh: 她成为争取清洁空气运动中的显要人物。

words.note: prominent 指位置突出或地位显要；pro- 表向前。

ex.en: Two students were expelled from school for cheating in the exam.
ex.zh: 两名学生因考试作弊被开除学籍。

words.note: expel 常用被动 be expelled from；ex-（出）+ pel（推）。

ex.en: Their superiority over the other team was clear from the first minute.
ex.zh: 他们比其他队的优势从第一分钟就显而易见。

words.note: superiority over 表「优于」；superior 本身含比较义。

ex.en: The risks were obvious from the outset, yet nobody raised any objection.
ex.zh: 从一开始风险就很明显，却没人提出异议。

words.note: outset 只用于 at/from the outset 这类短语中。

ex.en: Teachers are given considerable latitude in choosing classroom materials.
ex.zh: 教师在选用课堂材料上有相当大的自由。

words.note: latitude 本义「纬度」，引申为行动自由、回旋余地。

ex.en: He scanned the headlines quickly before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 上班前他快速浏览了一下新闻标题。

words.note: scan 既指细看也指快速浏览，另指扫描文件。

ex.en: The exhibition was organized in association with the city museum.
ex.zh: 这次展览是与市博物馆合作举办的。

words.note: in association with 表合作；该词也可指「联想」。

ex.en: Trust is fundamental to any lasting relationship between people.
ex.zh: 信任是人与人之间任何长久关系的基础。

words.note: fundamental to 中 to 是介词；词根 fund 表基础。
